scenarios.title: A｜正常送达
scenarios.setting: 在“让工作人员把用品送到房间”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“正常送达”。

turns.prompt: 你想回应上门送物品的工作人员，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi. Yes, come in, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. Yes, come in, please.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Just a moment, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just a moment, please.
feedback.explanation: “just a moment”是请对方稍等片刻的口语说法，通常不是精确计时。

choices.text: Hi, I requested some extra towels.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I requested some extra towels.
feedback.explanation: “I requested”说明自己此前提出的需求，便于对方核对是否遗漏或送错。

choices.text: Wait me one minute.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. Yes, come in, please.
feedback.explanation: “wait”后接人需要“for”；也可直接说“Just a moment, please”，自然请对方稍等。

turns.text: Of course. I have two towels and an extra blanket for you.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, that’s everything I requested. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, that’s everything I requested. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “that’s everything”表示目前没有其他需求，适合结束一次服务问答。

choices.text: Perfect. That’s exactly what I needed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. That’s exactly what I needed.
feedback.explanation: “that’s exactly what”表示刚提供的内容正好符合自己的需要，可以结束进一步确认。

choices.text: Yes, those are for me. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, those are for me. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Yes, these are all my things.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great, that’s everything I requested. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 这句强调物品属于自己；若要确认送齐了，应该说“everything I requested”，突出与请求清单一致。

turns.text: Is there anything else you need?

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, that’s all. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, that’s all. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: That’s everything, thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s everything, thanks.
feedback.explanation: “that’s everything”表示目前没有其他需求，适合结束一次服务问答。

choices.text: Actually, could I get one more pillow as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, could I get one more pillow as well?
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

choices.text: No, I don’t need something else.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, that’s all. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 一般否定句中“别的东西”用“anything else”；也可简洁回应“No, that’s all”。

turns.text: Of course. Have a good evening.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: You too. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: You too. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Thanks. Have a good evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Have a good evening.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜等了很久还没送到
scenarios.setting: 在“让工作人员把用品送到房间”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“等了很久还没送到”。

turns.text: Front desk. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「让工作人员把用品送到房间」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I called earlier and asked for some extra towels, but they haven’t arrived yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I called earlier and asked for some extra towels, but they haven’t arrived yet.
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: Hi, I’m still waiting for the towels I requested.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m still waiting for the towels I requested.
feedback.explanation: “I requested”说明自己此前提出的需求，便于对方核对是否遗漏或送错。

choices.text: I requested some towels about half an hour ago, but I haven’t received them yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I requested some towels about half an hour ago, but I haven’t received them yet.
feedback.explanation: “half an hour”表示半小时，用来交代已等待或预计需要的时长。

choices.text: I asked towels thirty minutes ago, but nobody came.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I called earlier and asked for some extra towels, but they haven’t arrived yet.
feedback.explanation: 索要物品用“ask for towels”；补上“for”，并说明尚未送达，就能清楚反映等待问题。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. What room are you in?

turns.prompt: 告诉对方你的房间号，方便对方处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m in room 806.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: Room 806. I called about thirty minutes ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: Room 806. I called about thirty minutes ago.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: It’s room 806. Could you check on the request for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s room 806. Could you check on the request for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Let me check… Yes, I can see your request. Housekeeping is quite busy tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想了解还需要多少时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know how much longer it will take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer it will take?
feedback.explanation: “How much longer”问还要多久，关注从现在起剩余的等待时间。

choices.text: Could you tell me when they’ll arrive?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me when they’ll arrive?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there any way to have them sent up soon?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way to have them sent up soon?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: I’ve already been waiting for thirty minutes.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer it will take?
feedback.explanation: 等待时长说得清楚；再接一句询问预计送达时间，能把不满转成具体请求。

choices.text: How long I still need to wait?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer it will take?
feedback.explanation: 直接问句需要助动词“do”；“How much longer do I need to wait?”是在问还要等多久。

turns.text: I apologize for the delay. I’ll contact housekeeping now. They should be there within ten minutes.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thank you for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: All right. I’ll wait another ten minutes. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I’ll wait another ten minutes. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate it if they could bring them soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d appreciate it if they could bring them soon.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Okay, but please don’t make me wait too long.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: “don’t make me wait”像在责怪对方让你等；问预计还要多久，更便于得到具体答复。

turns.text: Of course. Sorry again about the delay.

scenarios.title: C｜工作人员送错东西
scenarios.setting: 在“让工作人员把用品送到房间”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“工作人员送错东西”。

turns.text: Housekeeping. I have the items you requested.

turns.prompt: 关于「让工作人员把用品送到房间」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi. I think there might be a mistake.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I think there might be a mistake.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Sorry, I don’t think this is what I requested.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I don’t think this is what I requested.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Excuse me, I think you may have brought the wrong items.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think you may have brought the wrong items.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: This is wrong.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I think there might be a mistake.
feedback.explanation: “wrong”没有指出错在哪里；说明原要的物品与送来的物品，工作人员才能及时更换。

choices.text: You bring me wrong things.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I think there might be a mistake.
feedback.explanation: 已发生的送错用“brought”，并说“the wrong items”；也可以先说可能有误，便于对方核对。

turns.text: Oh, I’m sorry. What did you request?

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I asked for two extra pillows, not two towels.

feedback.naturalExpression: I asked for two extra pillows, not two towels.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I requested a blanket and an extra pillow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I requested a blanket and an extra pillow.
feedback.explanation: “I requested”说明自己此前提出的需求，便于对方核对是否遗漏或送错。

choices.text: I think these towels are for another room. I asked for some hangers.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think these towels are for another room. I asked for some hangers.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I wanted a phone charger, not an adapter.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted a phone charger, not an adapter.
feedback.explanation: 用“not an adapter”明确区分充电器与转接头，让工作人员知道哪件用品送错了。

choices.text: I asked two pillows, not towels.

feedback.naturalExpression: I asked for two extra pillows, not two towels.
feedback.explanation: “ask for”表示索要；省掉“for”就无法自然连接所要的物品。

turns.text: I apologize. Let me check the request… You’re right. There must have been a mix-up.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. Could you bring the correct items, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Could you bring the correct items, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: That’s okay. Could you bring me the two pillows instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Could you bring me the two pillows instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you exchange these for the items I requested?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you exchange these for the items I requested?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can you change these to pillows?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Could you bring the correct items, please?
feedback.explanation: 这句能理解，但“change these to pillows”像把毛巾变成枕头；请对方送来正确用品更直接。

choices.text: Can you bring me right things?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Could you bring the correct items, please?
feedback.explanation: “正确的用品”用“the correct items / the right items”；“right things”前不能省去限定词。

turns.text: Of course. I’ll bring them up right away.

turns.prompt: 你想确认送错的用品应如何退回，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you want me to give these towels back to you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you want me to give these towels back to you?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: Should I return these to you now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I return these to you now?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Would you like to take these back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you like to take these back?
feedback.explanation: 先询问对方的意愿或偏好，再作安排，让对方参与选择。

choices.text: These towels need return?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you want me to give these towels back to you?
feedback.explanation: 可问“Do these towels need to be returned?”；原句缺少助动词和被动结构。

turns.text: Yes, I’ll take them with me. I’ll be back with your pillows in a few minutes.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: No problem. Thanks for sorting it out.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thanks for sorting it out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll wait here. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll wait here. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
